school.name: The Classroom
school.tagline: learn it, practise it, score it
school.intro: Pick a course to start. Every chapter has a lesson, worked problems you reveal step by step, a lab bench to play with, flashcards, a pop quiz and a printable cheat sheet. Your stars are saved in this browser.

courses.title: Deep Neural Networks
courses.description:
- **Textbook:** Zhang, Lipton, Li & Smola, *Dive into Deep Learning* (2023)
- **Mid-sem:** EC-2, closed book (done)
- **Exam:** EC-3 comprehensive, **5 Dec 2026**
- **Format:** open book · all topics

chapters.title: Introduction to Deep Learning
chapters.blurb: What DL is, why now, and the four parts of every learning problem.

chapters.title: Artificial Neuron & Perceptron
chapters.blurb: From biological neurons to the perceptron rule, logic gates and XOR.

chapters.title: Linear Neural Networks for Regression
chapters.blurb: One neuron that answers "how much": squared loss and batch gradient descent.

chapters.title: Linear Neural Networks for Classification
chapters.blurb: Sigmoid + BCE with SGD, softmax + cross-entropy with mini-batches, metrics.

chapters.title: Deep Feedforward Networks
chapters.blurb: Hidden layers, activations, forward pass and backpropagation by hand.

chapters.title: Convolutional Neural Networks
chapters.blurb: Convolution, padding, stride, pooling, parameters, ResNet and transfer learning.

chapters.title: Recurrent Neural Networks
chapters.blurb: Sequences, BPTT, vanishing gradients, GRU and LSTM.

chapters.title: Attention Mechanism
chapters.blurb: Context bottleneck, Q-K-V, scaled dot product, Bahdanau, self/cross/masked/multi-head, positional encoding.

chapters.title: Transformers
chapters.blurb: Encoder and decoder blocks, parameter counts, ViT, BERT/GPT/T5 families, fine-tuning.

chapters.title: Optimizers
chapters.blurb: Momentum, Nesterov, AdaGrad, RMSprop, Adam/AdamW, schedules, clipping and tuning.

chapters.label: Mid-sem · EC-2R
chapters.title: Mid-Semester, Mar 2026
chapters.blurb: Closed book, 30 marks. Metrics, perceptron network, backprop, GD + normal equations, overfitting.

chapters.label: Comprehensive · EC-3R
chapters.title: Comprehensive, May 2026
chapters.blurb: Open book, 40 marks. Exploding gradients, domain shift, attention, scaling, conv filters, momentum.

chapters.label: Mid-sem · 2023 regular
chapters.title: Mid-Semester 2023-24 (Regular)
chapters.blurb: NOR perceptron, Boolean MLP, 6-input XOR, BCE derivative, ReLU graph, learning-rate bounds.

chapters.label: Mid-sem · 2023 makeup
chapters.title: Mid-Semester 2023-24 (Makeup)
chapters.blurb: Perceptron epoch, CCE derivative, rectangle MLP, GD, sigmoid graph, cubic surface.

chapters.label: End-sem · 2023 makeup
chapters.title: End-Semester 2023-24 (Makeup)
chapters.blurb: LeNet+RNN captioner, multi-head shapes, NiN params, Keras CNN fill-in, GRU params.

groupIntros.Exam hall: Past papers, solved step by step. Your next exam: **EC-3 comprehensive, 5 Dec 2026** (open book).

courses.title: Introduction to Statistical Methods
courses.description:
- **Textbooks:** T1 Kaptein et al., *Statistics for Data Scientists*; T2 Devore, *Probability and Statistics for Engineering and the Sciences*; T3 Brockwell & Davis, *Introduction to Time Series and Forecasting*
- **Exam:** EC-3 comprehensive
- **Format:** open book · 40% of the course
- **Pre-mid syllabus:** CS 1–7, roughly 10–15% of end-sem marks; the rest comes from CS 9 onwards

chapters.title: Descriptive Statistics
chapters.blurb: Central tendency, spread, skew, outliers, five-number summary.

chapters.title: Probability Basics
chapters.blurb: Axioms, addition rule, mutually exclusive vs independent events.

chapters.title: Conditional & Total Probability
chapters.blurb: Conditioning, independence, the law of total probability.

chapters.title: Bayes' Theorem & Naïve Bayes
chapters.blurb: Bayes with proof, Naïve Bayes classification, Laplace smoothing.

chapters.title: Random Variables
chapters.blurb: Discrete and continuous, expectation, variance, joint distributions.

chapters.title: Probability Distributions
chapters.blurb: Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson, Normal; t, F and χ² introduced.

chapters.title: Sampling & Estimation
chapters.blurb: Sampling distributions, CLT, point and interval estimation.

chapters.title: Hypothesis Testing
chapters.blurb: H₀/H₁, errors, p-values, z and t tests, proportions, paired data, chi-square.

chapters.title: Maximum Likelihood & ANOVA
chapters.blurb: MLE for Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson and Normal, F-test for two variances, one-way and two-way ANOVA.

chapters.title: Correlation & Regression
chapters.blurb: Covariance, Pearson r, autocovariance and autocorrelation, PCA. Regression line, r², Spearman, and every past-paper question type.

chapters.title: Prediction & Forecasting
chapters.blurb: Trend, seasonality, moving averages.

chapters.title: Time Series Models
chapters.blurb: AR, MA, ARMA, ARIMA.

chapters.title: Smoothing & Time-series Models
chapters.blurb: Simple exponential smoothing (worked), videos, and a red pending board for Holt, moving averages and SARIMA to VARMAX.

chapters.title: Gaussian Mixture Models & EM
chapters.blurb: Soft clustering, mixtures of Gaussians, expectation-maximisation.

chapters.label: CS 9
chapters.title: Support Vector Machines
chapters.blurb: Linear and non-linear SVM, kernels, support vectors. Before: dot product, ‖w‖, distance from a point to a line; Lagrange/KKT (MFML L14–15).

chapters.label: CS 14
chapters.title: Unsupervised Learning
chapters.blurb: K-means, Gaussian mixture models, EM. Before: Gaussian density and MLE (CS 10–11). Do K-means, then GMM.

chapters.label: CS 12–13
chapters.title: Ensemble Learning
chapters.blurb: Voting, bagging, Random Forest, AdaBoost, gradient boosting, XGBoost, stacking. Before: decision stumps (CS 6, idea only); residuals and squared loss (CS 3) for gradient boosting.

chapters.label: CS 10–11
chapters.title: Bayesian Learning
chapters.blurb: MLE, MAP, Bayes optimal classifier, Naive Bayes. Before: Bayes' theorem, Gaussian density.

chapters.label: CS 7
chapters.title: Instance-based Learning
chapters.blurb: kNN, locally weighted regression, radial basis functions. Before: min–max normalisation; linear regression and one GD step (CS 3) for LWR.

chapters.label: CS 3
chapters.title: Linear Models for Regression
chapters.blurb: Direct solution, gradient descent, basis functions, bias-variance, Ridge and Lasso.

chapters.label: CS 6
chapters.title: Decision Trees
chapters.blurb: Entropy, information gain, overfitting, continuous and missing values.

chapters.label: CS 4–5
chapters.title: Linear Classification and Logistic Regression
chapters.blurb: Discriminant functions, logistic regression, log loss, multi-class.

chapters.label: CS 15
chapters.title: Model Evaluation
chapters.blurb: Comparing models, confusion matrix, bias and fairness. Not in past papers, but cheap marks: do a short pass.

weight.note: 4 marks in Sourabh sir's Practice Paper 01

chapters.label: CS 1
chapters.title: Introduction
chapters.blurb: What ML is, how a learning system is designed, issues in ML.

chapters.label: CS 2
chapters.title: Maths Preliminaries and ML Workflow
chapters.blurb: Linear algebra, calculus, probability, information theory, data pre-processing.

chapters.label: End-sem · Mar 2026 regular
chapters.title: Comprehensive, Mar 2026 (Regular)
chapters.blurb: Lasso vs ensemble, Gower kNN, AdaBoost, multinomial NB, SVM margin, K-means vs GMM, linear/logistic/tree.

chapters.label: End-sem · Mar 2026 makeup
chapters.title: Comprehensive, Mar 2026 (Makeup)
chapters.blurb: Ridge λ, Gaussian NB, kNN + LWR, bagging/RF/voting, GMM EM step, gradient boosting, SVM, tree overfitting.

chapters.label: End-sem · 2021 regular
chapters.title: End-Semester 2021-22 (Regular)
chapters.blurb: Bayes optimal, kernel trick, EM with one Gaussian, coin MLE, XOR, SVM what-ifs, AdaBoost, K-means starts.

chapters.label: End-sem · 2021 makeup
chapters.title: End-Semester 2021-22 (Makeup)
chapters.blurb: kNN k=3/5/7, kernel trick, regression through origin, information gain, die MLE, SVM, AdaBoost, K-means outlier.

chapters.label: Sourabh sir
chapters.title: Practice Paper 01
chapters.blurb: Sit it under exam conditions first. Least squares and ridge, kNN + LWR, SVM kernels, MLE, gradient boosting, K-means starts, confusion matrices.

groupIntros.Exam hall: All four previous end-sem papers, solved step by step. Start with the two Mar 2026 papers: they match the current style.
groupIntros.Syllabus board: Sorted by end-sem marks across all four past papers, highest first. Each card says what to study before it.
groupIntros.Try it on your own: Sourabh sir's full practice paper. Attempt it under exam conditions before opening the solutions.

target.text: Master the **top five chapters**. In the two Mar 2026 papers they carried **68 of 80 marks (about 34 per paper)**, so solving them reliably is enough for 30.

courses.title: Mathematical Foundations for Machine Learning
courses.description:
- **Textbook:** T1 Deisenroth, Faisal & Ong, *Mathematics for Machine Learning*
- **Exam:** EC-3 comprehensive, **6 Dec 2026 (morning)**
- **Format:** open book · 150 minutes · 40% of the course
- **Pre-mid syllabus:** lectures 1–8, which took 35–45% of the marks in the Feb and Mar 2026 end-sem papers

chapters.label: L9
chapters.title: Gradient Descent
chapters.blurb: Loss, the GD rule, step size, decay, line search, SGD. Practice and past-paper problems.

chapters.label: L10
chapters.title: Optimisation I
chapters.blurb: Initialisation, scaling, SGD in machine learning.

chapters.label: L11
chapters.title: Optimisation II
chapters.blurb: Momentum, AdaGrad, RMSProp, Adam; convex sets, LP and the Lagrangian.

chapters.label: L12
chapters.title: PCA I
chapters.blurb: Maximum variance and projection views.

chapters.label: L13
chapters.title: PCA II
chapters.blurb: Eigenvectors, low-rank approximation, steps in practice.

chapters.label: L14
chapters.title: Constrained Optimisation, KKT and Linear Classifiers
chapters.blurb: Primal and dual, KKT, kernels, the SVM setup.

chapters.label: L15
chapters.title: SVM
chapters.blurb: Hard and soft margin, the dual, kernels.
